verdict_reason: The new UI helpers copy party-choice and submit steps AnimalsJourney already owns, putting browser walking in the seeding flow.

todos.issue: UI walking added to the seeding flow copies steps AnimalsJourney already owns: choosePartyInUi (seeded-journey.ts:135-145) repeats the click/select/saveAndContinue/heading-wait body of AnimalsJourney.addParties (journey.ts:280-288), and createSubmittedWithPlaceOfOriginChosenInUi lines 125-131 repeat AnimalsJourney.continueFromReviewToDeclaration + confirmDeclaration (journey.ts:784-792, exposed as submitFromReview). It also takes role and picker as two parameters that must agree, where AnimalsJourney.partyPicker(role) (journey.ts:563) already derives the picker, and needs a new alias PartyRole as AddressesPartyRole (line 3) for the type journey.ts imports as PartyRole.
todos.fix: Must: one home for choosing a party on Roles and addresses and for submitting from the review page; AnimalsSeededJourney seeds only and does not drive the UI with its own copies of those steps. One way: add a changeParty(role, name) beside addParties on AnimalsJourney (sharing a private pick-in-picker helper resolved by partyPicker(role)), have the specs seed with animalsSeededJourney.createDraftNotification() then call animalsJourney methods (resume, changeParty, submitFromReview), and delete choosePartyInUi and the AddressesPartyRole alias.
